# `PropertyEvent`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Event\PropertyEvent`

**Interface** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Event/PropertyEvent.php#L16) — **Version:** working tree

**Implemented by:** [`Event\CorpusPruned`](/api/classes/Event/CorpusPruned), [`Event\CorpusReplayed`](/api/classes/Event/CorpusReplayed), [`Event\CorpusStored`](/api/classes/Event/CorpusStored), [`Event\ExampleFinished`](/api/classes/Event/ExampleFinished), [`Event\ExampleStarted`](/api/classes/Event/ExampleStarted), [`Event\PropertyFinished`](/api/classes/Event/PropertyFinished), [`Event\PropertyStarted`](/api/classes/Event/PropertyStarted), [`Event\RunDiscarded`](/api/classes/Event/RunDiscarded), [`Event\RunFailed`](/api/classes/Event/RunFailed), [`Event\RunPassed`](/api/classes/Event/RunPassed), [`Event\RunStarted`](/api/classes/Event/RunStarted), [`Event\ShrinkAccepted`](/api/classes/Event/ShrinkAccepted), [`Event\ShrinkTried`](/api/classes/Event/ShrinkTried)

Marker for the engine's lifecycle events.

Events carry engine data only — property id, seed, attempt numbers,
arguments, labels, elapsed time, failures, counterexamples. Framework types
(Testo's TestInfo/TestResult/Messenger, PHPUnit's) never appear here.

No public members beyond what is documented above.
